description: A modern CLI tool that keeps your deps fresh.

next.name: default
tip: Only bump versions in the ranges specified in package.json (safe, default behavior).

next.name: latest
tip: Bump to the version marked by the registry `latest` dist-tag.

next.name: major
tip: Check all changes and bump to the latest stable changes, including majors (breaking changes).

next.name: minor
tip: Bump to the latest minor changes within the same major version.

next.name: newest
tip: Bump to the newest published version, including prereleases.

next.name: next
tip: Bump to the version marked by the registry `next` dist-tag (falls back to newest).

next.name: patch
tip: Bump to the latest patch changes within the same minor version.

next.name: stable
tip: Bump to the latest stable version within the current range, honoring the maturity period.

option.name: --all
tip: Show info of all packages, including up-to-date ones.

option.name: --concurrency
tip: Number of concurrent requests when resolving dependencies (default: 10).

option.name: --cwd
tip: Specify the current working directory.

option.name: --exclude
tip: Exclude dependencies to be checked, will override --include options. Supports `name@range` (e.g. typescript@7) to exclude only matching versions.

option.name: --fail-on-outdated
tip: Exit with code 1 if outdated dependencies are found.

option.name: --fast-npm-meta-api-endpoint
tip: API endpoint for fetching npm package metadata via fast-npm-meta.

option.name: --force
tip: Force fetching from server, bypass cache.

option.name: --github-actions-style
tip: How to write updated GitHub Actions references.

next.name: auto
tip: Preserve each action's existing style (default).

next.name: sha
tip: Always write a commit-SHA reference with a version comment.

next.name: tag
tip: Always write a tag reference.

option.name: --global
tip: Update global packages.

option.name: --group
tip: Group dependencies by source on display.

option.name: --ignore-other-workspaces
tip: Ignore package.json that in other workspaces (with their own .git, pnpm-workspace.yaml, etc.) (default: true).

option.name: --ignore-paths
tip: Ignore paths for search package.json.

option.name: --include
tip: Only included dependencies will be checked for updates.

option.name: --include-locked
tip: Include locked dependencies & devDependencies.

option.name: --install
tip: Install directly after bumping.

option.name: --interactive
tip: Interactive mode.

option.name: --json
tip: Output update info as JSON (implies non-interactive).

option.name: --loglevel
tip: Log level.

option.name: --maturity-period
tip: Wait period in days before upgrading to newly released packages (default: 7 when flag is used, 0 when not used).

option.name: --maturity-period-exclude
tip: Dependencies to exclude from the maturity period filter.

option.name: --no-github-actions
tip: Disable checking GitHub Actions in .github/workflows and composite action.yml files.

option.name: --no-node-version
tip: Disable checking .node-version and .nvmrc files.

option.name: --no-retry
tip: Disable retries when fetching package metadata.

option.name: --nodecompat
tip: Show package compatibility with current node version.

option.name: --peer
tip: Include peerDependencies in the update process.

option.name: --recursive
tip: Recursively search for package.json in subdirectories.

option.name: --request-timeout
tip: Request timeout in milliseconds when fetching package metadata (default: 5000).

option.name: --retry
tip: Number of retries when fetching package metadata fails, use --no-retry to disable (default: 4).

option.name: --retry-factor
tip: Exponential backoff factor between retries (default: 2).

option.name: --retry-max-timeout
tip: Maximum milliseconds between two retries (default: Infinity).

option.name: --retry-min-timeout
tip: Milliseconds before starting the first retry (default: 1000).

option.name: --retry-randomize
tip: Randomize retry timeouts by a factor between 1 and 2.

option.name: --silent
tip: Complete silent.

option.name: --sort
tip: Sort by most outdated absolute or relative to dependency.

next.name: diff-asc
tip: Sort by version diff, smallest first.

next.name: diff-desc
tip: Sort by version diff, largest first.

next.name: name-asc
tip: Sort by package name, A to Z.

next.name: name-desc
tip: Sort by package name, Z to A.

next.name: time-asc
tip: Sort by publish time, oldest first.

next.name: time-desc
tip: Sort by publish time, newest first.

option.name: --timediff
tip: Show time difference between the current and the updated version.

option.name: --update
tip: Update directly after bumping.

option.name: --version
tip: Display version number.

option.name: --write
tip: Write to package.json.

global_option.name: --help
tip: Display this message.
